content.title: VANUATU: Ever heard of this PARADISE!? Amazing WATERFALLS, Beaches, Hotels & FIRE Shows in 4K!
content.text: Forget Hawaii or Bali, because this paradise is better! Vanuatu is the tropical paradise with undiscovered beaches, nature, waterfalls and is the ULTIMATE holiday destination! We couldn't believe it ourselves, but the at the waterfalls, beaches and jungle lagoons we were completely alone! Check the video till the end and find out why this paradise STILL has the real Pacific charm. NO mass tourism, no crime, no hassle, but only relaxation. We first blend in with local life, hitting the local fruit and fish market. There is also a unique underwater post office. From the capital Port Vila we head to a jungle resort on the beach side with the most beautiful colored reefs. We spot turtles and all kinds of fish, before dining at a cultural fire show! On the other side of the island we discover a blue lagoon, the most incredible turquoise beaches and much more adventure. As a family we left home to pursue our dream of traveling and making videos. There are already hundreds of our travel videos all over the world! Join us on every adventure and subscribe! Now in Australia and then to many more beautiful destinations! We travel non-stop all year round and film everything.
